children_texts: The foundation of officer entry into the Armed Forces.
The NDA program is the foundation of officer entry into the Armed Forces and is our primary focus. At Sabre Officers Defense Academy, we don
Comprehensive coverage of Mathematics and GAT (General Ability Test) with expert faculty.
Building the right mindset and psychological readiness for the SSB interview early on.
Cultivating officer-like qualities, routine, and strict discipline essential for defense forces.
Continuous assessment, progress tracking, and strategic feedback to ensure exam readiness.
Class 10–12 students who are serious about building a dedicated career in the defense forces.
Conceptual clarity, speed, and strategic exam execution.

CDS preparation requires a deep level of conceptual clarity, high speed, and a robust exam strategy. Our program is meticulously designed for graduates aiming to join the Indian Army, Navy, or Air Force.
Rigorous coaching covering English, General Knowledge, and Elementary Mathematics.
Targeted approaches for each subject to maximize scoring potential and manage time effectively.
Confidence building, communication skills, and personality development for the subsequent interview stage.
Regular evaluations and personalized feedback loops to track and improve performance.
Graduates preparing for entry into the Indian Army, Navy, or Air Force through the CDS examination.
Balanced approach across aptitude, reasoning, and awareness.

AFCAT requires a balanced approach across numerical ability, reasoning, military aptitude, and general awareness. Our program ensures you are ready to secure your place as an officer in the Indian Air Force.
Comprehensive syllabus coverage including Verbal Ability, Numerical Ability, Reasoning, and General Awareness.
Intensive practice sessions designed to improve speed and accuracy under exam conditions.
Pre-SSB preparation focusing on communication, group discussions, and psychological readiness.
Flexible learning options incorporating both physical classes and digital resources.
Graduates aspiring for prestigious officer roles (Flying and Ground Duty) in the Indian Air Force.
SSB is not an exam. It is an assessment of personality and leadership.
The Services Selection Board (SSB) interview evaluates a candidate
Extensive practice in Group Discussions (GD), Group Planning Exercises (GPE), and clear articulation.
Cultivating the 15 core OLQs required by the Armed Forces through practical exercises and mentorship.
Preparation for TAT, WAT, SRT, and SD tests to ensure your psychological profile aligns with military expectations.
Mock interviews and personal feedback from former armed forces officers to simulate the exact SSB environment.
Candidates appearing for the SSB interview after successfully clearing their respective written exams (NDA, CDS, AFCAT, etc).
Lead the Central Armed Police Forces with excellence.

The CAPF (Assistant Commandant) examination is one of the most prestigious entries into the paramilitary forces of India. At Sabre Officers Defense Academy, we provide a specialized curriculum that covers both Paper I and Paper II, along with physical and personality preparation.
In-depth coverage of General Ability, Intelligence, and General Studies with descriptive writing practice.
Understanding the unique roles of BSF, CRPF, CISF, ITBP, and SSB.
Guidance and training to meet the rigorous physical efficiency tests (PET) required for CAPF.
Mock interviews conducted by experts to refine your leadership and decision-making qualities.
Graduates aged 20-25 aiming to serve as Assistant Commandants in the Central Armed Police Forces.
Building a strong base before formal NDA preparation.

Our Foundation Course is designed to help younger students build a robust academic and disciplinary base before stepping into formal NDA preparation. We focus on early awareness and gradual development.
Strengthening core subjects like Mathematics, Science, and English right from the school level.
Instilling a structured daily routine, physical fitness habits, and a defense-oriented mindset.
Educating students about the structure, life, and requirements of the Indian Armed Forces.
A stress-free, step-by-step approach ensuring students are fully prepared by the time they reach Class 12.
School students who are planning early to build a successful and disciplined career in the defense forces.
Stay updated with the latest happenings for your defense exams.
